input.quote: 19.4 For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it. This remedy is not exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security, or indemnified claims.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position. Vendor warrants professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1), material conformity of Deliverables to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after delivery or acceptance (whichever is later) with Hosted Services conforming throughout the subscription term (19.2), no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law (19.3). The remedy in 19.4 is real and escalating: prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, with termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure, and it is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty. No redline needed.
